cash_transfers_void.name: cash_transfers_void
cash_transfers_void.value: ("cash_transfers"."status" = 'voided') = ("cash_transfers"."void_entry_id" is not null and "cash_transfers"."voided_at" is not null and "cash_transfers"."void_reason" is not null)

commissions_rate.name: commissions_rate
commissions_rate.value: ("commissions"."basis" = 'percent') = ("commissions"."rate" is not null and "commissions"."base_amount" is not null)

commissions_cancel.name: commissions_cancel
commissions_cancel.value: ("commissions"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("commissions"."cancel_entry_id" is not null and "commissions"."cancelled_at" is not null and "commissions"."cancel_reason" is not null)

deals_listing.name: deals_listing
deals_listing.value: ("deals"."deal_type" = 'sale' and "deals"."rental_id" is null) or ("deals"."deal_type" = 'rent' and "deals"."property_id" is null)

expense_categories_account.name: expense_categories_account
expense_categories_account.value: "expense_categories"."iqd_account_id" is not null or "expense_categories"."usd_account_id" is not null

leases_termination.name: leases_termination
leases_termination.value: ("leases"."status" = 'terminated') = ("leases"."termination_date" is not null and "leases"."termination_reason" is not null and "leases"."terminated_at" is not null)

leases_cancel.name: leases_cancel
leases_cancel.value: ("leases"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("leases"."cancelled_at" is not null and "leases"."cancel_reason" is not null)

leases_agreement_revision.name: leases_agreement_revision
leases_agreement_revision.value: "leases"."agreement_id" is null or "leases"."agreement_revision" is not null

leases_parties.name: leases_parties
leases_parties.value: "leases"."landlord_person_id" is null or "leases"."tenant_person_id" is null or "leases"."landlord_person_id" <> "leases"."tenant_person_id"

properties_location_range.name: properties_location_range
properties_location_range.value: ("properties"."latitude" IS NULL AND "properties"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("properties"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "properties"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "properties"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

rentals_location_range.name: rentals_location_range
rentals_location_range.value: ("rentals"."latitude" IS NULL AND "rentals"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("rentals"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "rentals"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "rentals"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "rentals"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

vouchers_lease.name: vouchers_lease
vouchers_lease.value: ("vouchers"."lease_id" is null or "vouchers"."purpose" = 'client_funds') and ("vouchers"."lease_installment_id" is null or ("vouchers"."lease_id" is not null and "vouchers"."kind" = 'receipt'))

vouchers_allocation.name: vouchers_allocation
vouchers_allocation.value: ("vouchers"."commission_id" is null or "vouchers"."kind" = 'receipt') and ("vouchers"."commission_split_id" is null or "vouchers"."kind" = 'payment')

vouchers_void.name: vouchers_void
vouchers_void.value: ("vouchers"."status" = 'voided') = ("vouchers"."void_entry_id" is not null and "vouchers"."voided_at" is not null and "vouchers"."void_reason" is not null)
